baseline_models.reading: Woe is pronounced upon those who short-measure: the focus condemns the agents of deficiency, identifying them by their conduct.

focus_anchor.role: The nominal warning attaches woe to a definite plural of agents who short-measure.

baseline_models.mechanism: The warning names a class by an active participial description rather than narrating one transaction. It therefore makes short-measuring a morally identifying practice, while leaving its detailed procedure and the realization of the woe unspecified.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The ordinary lexical and grammatical reading supplies short-measurers and a warning of misery. The packet supplies no mapped branch for ط ف ف. A characteristic practice is a natural reading of the designation, but the participle alone does not establish a frequency or minimum number of offenses.
baseline_models.containment: Do not invent a physical location named Woe, a particular punishment, a historical group, or a lexical branch for the unmapped focus root. The focus alone does not yet specify the receiving/giving asymmetry.

context_deltas.reading: The short-measurers operate a directional double standard: they insist on complete receipt from others and create deficiency when others receive from them.

focus_anchor.role: The following relative clause identifies precisely which conduct earns this designation.

activation_trace.role: The measuring-food scope explicitly includes both receiving and dispensing a measured amount; the receiving form selects one direction here.
Complete fullness without shortfall supplies the standard they demand for their own receipt.
The scope specifically identifies diminution during measuring or weighing, making the outgoing shortfall concrete.

structural_cues.role: Antecedent of the defining relative clause.

structural_cues.quote_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
structural_cues.role: The first conditional presents their insistence on full receipt from people.
The matched conditional reverses transaction direction while reversing the treatment of fullness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parallel if/when constructions hold the agents constant while switching who benefits. Thus the defect is a selective refusal of the very standard they recognize for themselves, not merely an inability to measure accurately.

changed_reading.before: A warning against people who give deficient measure.
changed_reading.after: A warning against self-favoring reciprocity: full entitlement for oneself and reduced entitlement for the other, in either measure or weight.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The direction and opposed results are supplied by the text and branch scopes. Describing this as a double standard is a relational inference requiring no added episode. The text does not specify the instrument, commodity, or technique of shorting.
context_deltas.containment: Retain actual measurement and weighing as the ordinary referents. Do not infer that all taking in full is condemned; its pairing with giving short is decisive.

context_deltas.reading: The woe confronts short-measurers with a future standing before the Lord of all worlds, where the people from whom they exact full measure belong to the same summoned human assembly as they do.

focus_anchor.role: The initially unspecified warning is placed under resurrection and universal lordship.

activation_trace.role: The resurrection and standing-before-the-Lord scope directly fits the announced assembly.
Lordship and obeyed authority relocate the agents beneath a superior authority.

structural_cues.role: Warning whose future horizon is elaborated.
People first appear as those from whom the short-measurers receive.
The demonstrative returns to the named agents and challenges their reckoning with resurrection.
The warning acquires a momentous future occasion.
Repeated people now stand collectively before one Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demonstrative ties resurrection to these agents, and repetition of people changes the social frame from transactions they manipulate to an assembly they do not control. Their practical self-exemption is challenged by shared subjection.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified woe attached to commercial wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: A warning of accountability on the great day, directed at people acting as though their position in exchange exempted them from a common authority.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Resurrection, the great day, and collective standing are textual. Shared subjection follows from the repeated people and universal Lord; an explicit promise of identical outcomes does not. The force of يظن can remain either strong recognition or even entertaining the prospect; the challenge works without fixing that degree.
context_deltas.containment: Do not turn shared standing into identical moral status, or assert that every short-measurer explicitly denies resurrection. The question can also expose conduct inconsistent with an acknowledged future.

context_deltas.reading: The woe belongs to a regime of recorded moral outcomes: those who manipulate what others receive are not thereby able to make the record of their conduct indeterminate.

focus_anchor.role: The warning against manipulation receives the subsequent contrast of recorded wickedness and righteousness.

activation_trace.role: Marked writing and administrative recording make the record an inscribed thing; the scope need not be narrowed to numerals.
The identical inscribed-record description applies on the contrasting righteous side.

structural_cues.role: The initial conduct-defined agents whose warning is being elaborated.
Introduces the wicked's book in the sequence following the warning.
Specifies marked inscription.
Contrasting book framed by matching syntax.
Repeats the same record-description across the moral contrast.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated inscribed book gives the initial threat an ordered evidentiary setting. The transaction can be made deficient, but the surrounding narrative places moral conduct under recorded differentiation rather than the agents' selective standards.

changed_reading.before: Short-measurers are threatened with misery and future standing.
changed_reading.after: Their warning unfolds within a recorded distinction of conduct and outcome, frustrating the practical assumption that successful manipulation settles the matter.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Books and marked inscription are supplied. Relating commercial manipulation to inability to evade a moral record is an inference from the sequence, not a statement that they falsified ledgers. The precise relation of the explanatory book phrases to Sijjin and Illiyyin remains open here.
context_deltas.containment: Do not translate مرقوم as necessarily numerically itemized, or infer exact accounting technology, record contents, or the cosmography of the two named destinations.

context_deltas.reading: The repeated woe makes short-measuring resonate with denial of recompense: the first warning is a concrete ethical instance within the later confrontation between denying judgment and encountering it.

focus_anchor.role: Its warning-plus-recipient construction is repeated for the deniers.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning and recompense identify the denied day as the occasion when conduct returns in judgment.

structural_cues.role: First warning with conduct-defined plural recipient.
Repeats the warning but makes its day explicit and names deniers.
A second defining relative clause specifies what is denied.
Locates denial in a morally transgressive agent.
The later warning becomes an encounter with fire.
The denied object becomes the present demonstrable reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated woe and parallel relative definitions connect transactional wrongdoing with the denial sequence. The later demonstrative reverses the agents' denial into confrontation, adding a specific horizon to the first threat.

changed_reading.before: Short-measuring is an isolated commercial offense receiving a general warning.
changed_reading.after: It is read within the moral contradiction of refusing a reckoning that the discourse will make unavoidable and present.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The warning repetition and denial-to-encounter reversal are supplied. Treating short-measuring as an enacted disregard of reckoning is interpretive; the text does not explicitly equate every member of the initial and later groups. A person may also short-measure despite verbally believing in judgment.
context_deltas.containment: Preserve the connection without making an unrestricted identity claim about short-measurers, deniers, wicked people, and unbelievers. Do not derive a blanket classification of individuals from the literary parallel.

context_deltas.reading: The short-measurer's apparent gain can be read as inward damage: the later account of acquired conduct overpowering hearts shows that gaining for oneself does not ensure a beneficial result for oneself.

focus_anchor.role: The agents defined by reducing others' receipt provide the concrete acquisition-pattern to which the later heart-description returns.

activation_trace.role: Self-acquisition of livelihood, money, or benefit supplies an economic resonance for what they kept earning.
The heart's scope as inward understanding lets acquired conduct affect the faculty receiving or rejecting the recited signs.

structural_cues.role: The focus identifies the agents of the self-benefiting shortfall.
Their insistence on full receipt makes self-acquisition salient.
Dismissive reception immediately precedes the diagnosis of the heart.

structural_cues.quote_ar: بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
structural_cues.role: The corrective clause makes what they kept acquiring the grammatical source of the heart's overwhelming.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earnings vocabulary returns the reading from outward quantities to the acquiring subject. An agent who obtains the whole for himself may be diminishing his own receptivity through what he acquires; the corrective بل makes the dismissal of signs a symptom rather than a neutral evaluation.

changed_reading.before: The short-measurer secures his own advantage while imposing deficiency on others.
changed_reading.after: His supposed advantage also belongs to a pattern of acquired conduct capable of overwhelming inward understanding, giving the woe an inward dimension before the later punishment.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The text states that what they kept earning overpowered their hearts. Reading commercial gain among those earnings is licensed by the opening but is not exhaustive: the phrase can cover their deeds more broadly. No specific physiological process or rust substance is supplied by the cited evidence.
context_deltas.containment: Do not reduce the heart-description to money alone or claim that every isolated transaction causes a specified degree of blindness. This is a contextual moral reading of the initial agents within the wider sequence.

context_deltas.reading: The warning does not close off desire for good things; the later command to compete redirects the acquisitive drive exposed in short-measuring toward the righteous reward.

focus_anchor.role: The condemned way of seeking advantage gains a contrasting, positively directed object of striving.

activation_trace.role: The scope ties rivalry to a thing's preciousness and the self's desire for it; the directive selects the valued reward as its object.

structural_cues.role: Names the condemned agents seeking advantage through deficient giving.
Their own complete receipt is the initial visible object of insistence.
Identifies the people and benefit on the positive side of the contrast.
Presents desirable provision received by the righteous.
Explicitly directs competition toward the depicted good.

context_deltas.mechanism: A condemnatory opening and a positive imperative frame two orientations of striving. The reward is desirable and received, but the agents associated with it are righteous, so the opening's demand for advantage is judged by its conduct and object rather than by the mere existence of desire.

changed_reading.before: The woe can be heard simply as suppression of self-interested acquisition.
changed_reading.after: It rejects obtaining one's advantage by diminishing others while the passage supplies a good toward which striving is expressly invited.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The imperative to compete and its referent are textual. Describing an acquisitive drive as redirected is a comparison with the opening, not a supplied psychology or explicit instruction to the short-measurers themselves. The scope includes envy and withholding as possibilities, but the positive command does not activate those as approved practices.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer that competitive fraud becomes acceptable for a religious end, or that the wine is a coded commercial commodity. The positive contrast concerns the direction of aspiration.

context_deltas.reading: The closing requital makes the opening woe a reversal of one-sided exchange: conduct comes back to its doer, under an order the short-measurer cannot keep tilted in his own favor.

focus_anchor.role: The initial adverse allocation is reread through the ending's question about returned recompense.

activation_trace.role: The image explicitly makes favorable or unfavorable recompense what returns to an agent from his action.

structural_cues.role: Opening warning to those responsible for deficient reciprocity.
The initial agents demand fullness for their own receipt.
They impose the opposite condition when others receive.
Earlier direction of laughter.
The same verb is retained while the laughing and laughed-at parties are reversed.

structural_cues.quote_ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
structural_cues.role: The final question interprets the reversal in relation to what its recipients used to do.

context_deltas.mechanism: The beginning exhibits reciprocity broken by the agents; the ending exhibits roles reversed and conduct returned as recompense. This formal correspondence lets the closing question sharpen the first woe as an answer to an unsustainable demand for exclusively favorable receipt.

changed_reading.before: Woe is an adverse consequence following short-measuring.
changed_reading.after: Woe can also be heard as the return of moral consequence to those who sought to govern only others' losses and their own gains.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Role reversal and recompense for deeds are supplied. Connecting them to the opening transaction asymmetry is a whole-window structural inference; it does not require an exact identity of all named groups. The ending does not specify a commodity-by-commodity restitution.
context_deltas.containment: Present returned consequence as a moral and literary relation, not as a precise formula of equal physical retaliation or authorization for private revenge.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The short-measurer can imaginatively become the object of valuation: the people standing before their Lord evoke a reversal from appraising quantities to having one's own conduct appraised.

focus_anchor.role: The agent of manipulated assessment is the figure whose position is reversed by the analogy.

activation_trace.role: The balance-of-justice scope bridges physical weighing and accounting of deeds.
The distinct valuation and pricing branch gives standing an associative contact with goods being appraised, without replacing the verb's ordinary sense.
The separate exact-coin-weight scope adds a material image of a standard that does not tilt; it remains a branch-distant echo.

structural_cues.role: Names the agents who manipulate quantitative evaluation.
Places deficient weighing immediately before resurrection is challenged.
People now occupy the position of standing before superior authority.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The close sequence of weighing and standing, supported by the distinct inventory images of appraisal and exact weight, permits a material analogy: those who manipulate evaluation enter an evaluation they cannot manipulate.

changed_reading.before: Short-measurers will stand before their Lord.
changed_reading.after: Their standing may additionally evoke a reversal in which the measurer is himself subject to a standard, like an item presented for untilted appraisal.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies all three branch scopes, but their simultaneous resonance is reader-supplied. Ordinary يقوم means standing here; it is not a grammatical instance of pricing or coin weighing. The text also supports accountability without this material analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it crosses from resurrection posture into market appraisal and coin standards. It remains anchored by the immediately preceding weighing and the focus's short-measuring agent. Use only as an exploratory image; do not translate يقوم as being priced, or claim an actual scale or monetary valuation of persons is described.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: Short-measuring can resonate beyond goods as withholding due regard: the later offenders reduce believers to objects of laughter and declare them astray while assuming an authority over them they were not given.

focus_anchor.role: The focus's agents of imposed deficiency become the anchor for an analogy of depreciating other people.

activation_trace.role: Standing or worth that carries weight supplies an explicit bridge from material weight to a person's valuation.
Making sport of people's reputations gives the cheerful return a possible predatory social resonance, additional to its ordinary delight.

structural_cues.role: Initial agents whose treatment of another's due is deficient.
The literal measurement relationship from which the social analogy starts.
Believers are made objects of the offenders' laughter.
Enjoyment accompanies the return to their own social circle.
They issue a depreciating verdict on those they see.
The text denies their appointment to an overseeing role over the others.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The social scene reproduces an asymmetry of self-authorized evaluation: others are diminished while the evaluators enjoy their own circle. The weight-as-worth branch and reputational consumption branch permit the focus to carry a figurative extension of its literal transaction pattern.

changed_reading.before: Short-measuring names deficient treatment of another's measurable goods.
changed_reading.after: It may also illuminate the later behavior as giving other people deficient recognition while arrogating the right to judge them.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: Mockery, the spoken verdict, and the denied appointment are supplied. Calling these a social short-measure, and hearing reputational consumption in فكهين, are reader-supplied analogies. Ordinary cheerful or insolent return remains fully viable; the text does not explicitly report backbiting during that return.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because a quantitative offense is carried into reputation and social judgment. It is anchored by actual weighing, the mapped worth-image, and the later depreciating treatment. Keep it a contextual analogy, not a replacement meaning of مطففين, and do not assume every later offender is literally a dishonest merchant.

summary.ordinary_reading: Woe to those who short-measure. The following ayat define their double standard: full receipt for themselves, deficient measure or weight for others.
coexisting_readings: The warning places self-favoring exchange under resurrection, shared human standing, and an authority beyond the agents' control.
The repeated woe and recorded outcomes connect commercial wrongdoing with reckoning and the later confrontation of denial by reality, without requiring all named groups to be identical.
The acquisition-pattern can be inwardly self-damaging, while the command to compete for the righteous reward redirects aspiration toward a positively valued end.
The closing reversal and requital let the opening woe be heard as conduct returning to its doer.
Exploratory analogies remain distinct: the measurer becomes subject to appraisal, and material short-measuring illuminates the withholding of due social regard.
unresolved_limits: The packet has no mapped branches for ط ف ف, the sole supplied focus root, or for غ م ز in 83:30. The ordinary focus reading is text-and-language based; no absent inventory has been reconstructed.
The exact force of يظن, the relations between all named moral groups, and the detailed nature of Sijjin and Illiyyin are not fixed by these readings.
Marked records need not be numeric ledgers; earned conduct need not be money alone; shared standing does not imply identical outcomes.
The valuation and reputational-shortfall outliers depend on reader-supplied cross-domain analogies. Their mapped branches do not make those senses the grammatical meanings of the local forms.
